title: Finite étale Artinian residue lift without flatness
statement: Let D and S be commutative local Artinian rings, with a local D-algebra structure on S. For every element b of the residue field of S separable over the residue field of D, there exist a finite étale local Artinian D-algebra D' and a local ring map g':D'→S factoring the structure map D→S, and d in D' whose image in the residue field of S is b. If D:Type u and S:Type v, D' can be taken in Type (max u v z) for any z. Flatness of D→S is not required.

source.place: Tag 07FI, finite étale extension and henselian factorization paragraphs

proof.text: Let $F=D/\mathfrak m_D$, $K=S/\mathfrak m_S$ and $E=F(b)\subseteq K$. Since $b$ is separable over $F$, the simple extension $E/F$ is finite separable and therefore finite étale.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: Artinian local rings D and S are Noetherian, have nilpotent maximal ideals and only one prime, hence are henselian. Essential surjectivity of the finite etale equivalence for D lifts E to a finite etale D-algebra D' with D'/m_D D'=E. The ideal m_D D' is nilpotent and the quotient is a field, so D' has only one prime and is local, and D→D' is local. Since D' is a finite module over an Artinian ring, it is Artinian (Mathlib instance IsArtinianRing.of_finite).

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: Form the étale $S$-algebra $B=S\otimes_D D_1$. Its reduction maps onto $K$ using $E\hookrightarrow K$ and the residue map $S\to K$; the kernel $Q$ is prime over $\mathfrak m_S$ and its residue field is $K$. Henselian étale retraction supplies $B\to S$ reducing to this map. Restriction to $D_1$ gives a map $g_1:D_1\to S$ factoring $D\to S$. It is local because $D_1$ has only one prime; it induces the specified embedding $E\to K$. Lift $b\in E$ through the quotient map of $D_1$ to an element $d$, so $\operatorname{res}_S(g_1(d))=b$. Transport the ring, algebra, map and properties through ULift to obtain the requested ambient universe.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_artinian_residue_lift_core
    (D : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing D] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] [IsLocalRing S] [IsArtinianRing S]
    [Algebra D S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap D S)]
    (b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
    (hb : IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D) b) :
    ∃ (D' : Type (max u v z)) (_ : CommRing D') (_ : Algebra D D') (g' : D' →+* S),
      IsLocalRing D' ∧ IsArtinianRing D' ∧
      IsLocalHom (algebraMap D D') ∧ IsLocalHom g' ∧
      Etale D D' ∧ Module.Finite D D' ∧
      g'.comp (algebraMap D D') = algebraMap D S ∧
      ∃ d : D', IsLocalRing.residue S (g' d) = b
